name: Hoof
overview: The Scriptures in Leviticus 11 emphasize the significance of the hoof as a physical characteristic used to distinguish ceremonially clean from unclean animals. Specifically, animals that both part the hoof and chew the cud are deemed clean and permissible to eat, while those that lack either trait, such as the camel, coney, hare, and swine, are considered unclean and forbidden. This distinction underscores God's holiness and the call for His people to observe His detailed commands regarding purity.
